campaigns.interpretation: Adaptive mechanism evidence disfavors a generic caution-text explanation: generic fence had 2/10 safety errors while epoch-structure-only and full Interlocus had zero effectful safety errors in valid trials. However standing/currentness errors remained in both structured arms and the experiment reused the observed N2 battlefield, so it supports only an epoch/currentness error-shaping mechanism candidate, not independent confirmation or deletion-essentiality.
campaigns.name: n2-adaptive-mechanism-ablation

established: Security raw evidence is in principle sufficient for the tested Range cases; the stronger model solved the migration-gap case without Interlocus projection.
Evidence sufficiency and finite-consumer representation sufficiency are distinct: neutral-label weak-model runs can derive the right facts in prose yet emit an unsafe structured standing/action.
The bounded Interlocus projection can change error frequency for a weaker model without contributing new Security facts or Security authority.
The tested projection is not deletion-essential: treatment also produced a safety error and a stronger model removed the residual in both arms.
Aggregate strictAccepted is a misleading primary metric here: both focused arms scored 17/20 strict despite 3 versus 1 safety errors because treatment had safe observation-specificity misses.
Interlocus truth/representation did not replace Security truth ownership in any valid focused trial.

A generic caution fence did not reproduce the apparent safety benefit in the adaptive N2 mechanism ablation; relation epoch/currentness structure is a more specific mechanism candidate than extra prompt caution.

Epoch/currentness structure was not sufficient for perfect semantic standing: epoch-only and full-Interlocus arms still produced binding-standing/observation misses, and one epoch-only trial was apparatus-invalid.
nextEscalationGate: Do not escalate J1 to J2 on this result. World enters only under independently constructed external-effect/trajectory non-identifiability where Security+Interlocus projections are identical but correct actions differ.

ownerBoundary.reasonWorldExcluded: The tested Security Range already owns authoritative world-truth for the controlled episode; no external trajectory/effect non-identifiability was present.

rejected: J1 establishes Interlocus x Security scoped complementarity.
J1 establishes emergence, higher-order irreducibility, or phase transition.
Security lacks the facts required to solve the tested controlled Range case.
The handcrafted projection should become shared production machinery based on this experiment.
World should be added to J1 merely because topology can change.
remainingHypotheses: Structured relation epoch/currentness representation may reduce effectful action errors for capacity-limited consumers even when it adds no owner facts.
The mechanism may be capacity-dependent: stronger consumers can reconstruct the same distinctions from raw Security evidence, while weaker consumers benefit from an explicit relation geometry.

The relevant variable may be structured applicability geometry rather than owner identity or generic caution text; a future test would need an independent natural consumer and held-out relation transitions to establish this.

A future positive cross-owner capability result still requires a natural consumer task where deleting the owner-preserving relation projection leaves a residual that cannot be eliminated by a stronger Security-local consumer at comparable conditions.
